title: Stopping at the anchor state
statement: Let $B$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ be one of its states, and let $c$ be a configuration on a Boolean input whose state is $a$. For any optional Boolean flag on the added tape, one step of the machine with the extra tape and release flag set to false yields the lifted configuration with the base machine halted, release flag false, and the added tape's cell zero set to false.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine over Booleans
A base configuration whose state is the anchor
An optional Boolean flag on the added tape
